settingsIntro.message: Choose when Firefox downloads should be checked by ClamAV.

automaticScanningDescription.message: Completed downloads are scanned and detected files are quarantined.

uploadScanningDescription.message: Recognizable file uploads are checked locally. The first risky upload is paused; repeat it within 15 minutes to continue.

cleanNotificationsDescription.message: Show a notification when a download was checked and no threat was found. Disabled by default.

parallelScansDescription.message: Number of files scanned at once. Minimum 1; maximum is half of the available CPU cores.

downloadQuarantinedMessage.message:
The file was isolated. Click this notification to review it in quarantine.

File: $filename$

downloadThreatMessage.message:
A threat was found. Review the scan result before using this file.

File: $filename$

downloadCleanMessage.message:
The download was scanned and no viruses were found.

File: $filename$

openQuarantine.message: Click this notification to open quarantine.

downloadScanFailedMessage.message: We could not complete the safety check for $filename$.

uploadThreatWarning.message: ClamAV warning: upload may be dangerous

uploadThreatMessage.message:
A threat was found. The upload was paused; review the file before trying again.

File: $file$

uploadScanIncomplete.message: ClamAV could not inspect an upload

uploadScanIncompleteMessage.message:
We could not complete the safety check. The upload was not blocked.

File: $file$
